title: Sky Elements drones fall from the sky over the East Field

tellings.quote: all of them start behaving mysteriously and start dropping like bricks from the sky.

plain: Between 2023 and 2025, a fleet of drones flown by a drone outfit called Sky Elements began acting strangely over a part of Skinwalker Ranch known as the East Field, or the triangle, and then dropped "like bricks from the sky". The story comes from Brandon Fugal, the owner of the ranch, who says he was there for it. To him it suggests that something on the property interferes with machines.
